title: Eco-Friendly Tiny House Nashville 10-Mins to DWTN
description:
Nestled 4 miles from iconic downtown Nashville, this cozy and private retreat provides a tiny house experience designed by the square inch. 

The 165-foot custom design will feel anything but tiny with its queen loft bed,  full kitchen and bathroom,  private keypad entrance, and your own designated parking spot. 

We provide all the amenities you will need to relax during your downtime during your trip to Nashville. 

Built using reclaimed materials.

The space
Enjoy premium roasted coffee, fair trade linens, and plastic-free toiletries (through The Good Fill), and know your stay is making a difference for the Earth!

We provide extra toiletries in case you forget yours and enhanced kitchen supplies so waffles or eggs can be on the menu for breakfast. 

The house manual will help you with technology instructions and our guidebook will help you with local food/park/coffee recommendations.

We engage in wildfire restoration by planting a tree for each booking through the Arbor Day Foundation in partnership with Grove Collaborative.

Guest access
Our tiny house is an addition to our primary residence. It is a completely separate space with its own private keypad entrance.

Other things to note
Our tiny house is an addition to our family's primary residence and is set up as a separate space with its own private entrance. We welcome all guests and the beautiful diversity they bring into our home. Our guest's privacy, security, and comfort are our top priorities as hosts.
